correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed all 3^5=243 words, discarded self-overlap at all proper prefix/suffix lengths, obtaining 144 eligible words and 3324 undirected compatibility edges requiring both cross-nonoverlap directions and Hamming distance≥2. Exhaustive independent bitset Bron–Kerbosch maximal-clique recursion yielded exact histogram {3:12,4:108,5:2436,6:7764,7:4356,8:1020,9:24}, so nine is global upper bound and attained exactly 24 times. Explicit action of S3 and full reversal partitions maxima into two disjoint 12-element orbits with verified Hamming spectra (21,10,5,0),(22,8,6,0). This is complete finite exhaustive proof for fixed alphabet/length, not extrapolation to other blocklengths. All graph vertices, edges and recursion invariants were checked, not only a saved terminal VERIFY_OK.
